title: TikTok — Native Feel, Trending Audio, Retention

slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Shoot lo-fi when the brand allows—polished reads as an ad.
Match the end frame to the start for seamless loops—the algorithm rewards rewatches.
Use trending audio inside your niche quickly—stale trends hurt reach.

slides.heading: LOOP + RETENTION
slides.caption: Native feel beats polished unless the brand demands polish.

slides.heading: HOW TO APPLY IT
steps: Match end frame to start for loops.
Use trending audio while it is still fresh.
State the payoff in the first 0.5 seconds.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Lo-fi BTS often outperforms glossy hero edits on TikTok.

slides.heading: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.text: Recycling Instagram polish without adapting pacing.
